name: Gokuin ~Orc ni Okasareru Elf no Onna Senshi~
original_name: 獄淫 ～オークに犯されるエルフの女戦士～
source:
Two races are caught in a neverending war. Orcs and elves.

The orcs have no females. Their species survives only through brutal aggression.

Elves are the perfect mates. Near-immortal, fertile, beautiful...

One protector of the Elven Queen is captured alive and r*ped in a prison...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE136525.html]DLsite English[/url]]
